$SDHC Support [Bero, ported by quatric]
*Machi e Ikou yo: Doubutsu no Mori (Japan, Rev 1)
*Adds SDHC (>2GB) SD card support.
*FOR RUUJ01 REVISION 1 ONLY -- check your disc version.
*Other revisions of RUUJ01 use different addresses and WILL crash.
* hook1 SD_GetDeviceStatus: latch SDHC bit
